findings.why: The drawing material in force for BR-225 is EN AW-6082-T6 (MAT-6082-T6). EN AW-7075 is a different alloy and not that grade. Nothing shows it meets the 250 MPa yield characteristic SC-BR225-YS.
The material master only lists the 6082 and 6061 alloys. EN AW-7075 has no entry and no id, and no yield data is available. A person must supply its data.
No 3.1 material certificate for EN AW-7075 is in the documents. A person must confirm whether one exists.
